title: Axes (skill)

infobox.Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Axes (skill).

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Axes (skill) is a skill related to the Axes weapons.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Higher skill level in axes reduces the stamina cost to swing axes down to -33% and increases damage done against non-trees up to +141%. The woodcutting skill affects damage to trees.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

sections.heading: Leveling up
sections.text: The player gains 1.5xp per attack when hitting a creature.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The fastest way to level up this skill is by using the Berserkir axes, since their attack speed is much higher than any other axe.

full_text:
Axes (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Axes (skill).

Introduction. Axes (skill) is a skill related to the Axes weapons.

Effects. Higher skill level in axes reduces the stamina cost to swing axes down to -33% and increases damage done against non-trees up to +141%. The woodcutting skill affects damage to trees.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

Leveling up. The player gains 1.5xp per attack when hitting a creature.

Notes. • The fastest way to level up this skill is by using the Berserkir axes, since their attack speed is much higher than any other axe.
